description.label: Description
description.value:
Kill Count Rank: Killer

Enemy Type: Free text. Set flags.wfrp4e-nom.killCountEnemy and/or rename this talent to Killer (Enemy) when awarding. Suggested examples: Beastmen, Orcs, Undead, Outlaws, Skaven, Chaos. Foe-specific bonuses do not apply while Enemy Type is blank.

Progression: For a single Enemy Type only the highest rank remains active (Reaper > Killer > Hunter). When awarding a higher rank, remove or supersede the lower rank for that enemy.

Requirements: The warrior has been an implacable foe of this enemy. Award this honor for successfully completing two or more adventures against a given adversary. Optionally, the GM can award the character this honor for 100 or more confirmed kills of a given enemy by the warrior.

Bonuses: You have experienced first-hand the behaviors and tactics of your foe and can now begin to predict their behaviors and exploit their idiosyncrasies. You gain a +10 to any Intelligence Tests having to do with the chosen enemy, including and especially Lore Tests. Additionally, you are extremely adept at combating your specific enemy and gain a bonus of +1 SL on all combat Tests against the specified threat.

Automation (Wave 2): Until automated, the GM applies the bonuses above manually when the medal is worn (Imperial Honors) or when the honor applies (Kill Counts).

Medal Notes (Kill Counts)

Kill Counts are informal honors (no physical medal required). Recipient rules for talents still apply; the GM enforces awards and superseding ranks.
